params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Shyvana's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} will reduce ''Emberstrike's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}. Against non-champions, this effect deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} ''Emberstrike'' can be cast twice in {{sbc|Human Form}} and thrice in {{sbc|{{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}}}}. Each cast empowers '''Shyvana's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and trigger an additional exclusive effect. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of using an ''Emberstrike'' attack, or immediately following a basic attack, the ability can be recast within and {{tt|up to|If the recast is gained by a followed-up basic attack, the window to use the recast is increased (minimum window of 2.5s)}} the next 4 seconds each time, before it incurs its {{sti|cooldown}}. '''Shyvana''' gains {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} on all of her basic attacks while ''Emberstrike'' is active. The attacks deal {{as|10 '''bonus''' physical damage}} against monsters.
params.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Shyvana''' slashes her claws, blasting a cone in the target's direction that deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to enemies hit. The damage to the primary target is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.<!--these casts are NOT on-hit!!! tested with eblade weapon-->
params.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Shyvana''' slams her tail, dealing the same damage to the target and surrounding enemies.
params.description5: {{sbc|{{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}} Bonus — Third Cast:}} '''Shyvana''' takes a bite out of the target, dealing {{ccs|{{sti|{{as|'''modified''' true damage}}}}|true}}. This damage cannot {{tip|critically strike}}.
params.description6: ''All casts {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Shyvana's''' basic attack timer.''
params.cdstart: Starts on-cast, but restarts each time an empowered attack is used
params.effect radius: <!--{{tip|Xr|icononly=true}}--> {{tt|275|First attack cone height and second attack blast radius}}
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target (attack target) and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets. The passive on-hit damage applies {{tip|proc damage}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will '''not''' block any damage nor be consumed by the strikes.
* The true damage is always equal to 150% of the {{tt|pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers}} physical damage.
* {{tip|Blind}} will negate the damage to the primary target, but not to any secondary targets.
* {{pft}} Interaction with parrying effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}).
* Only the last cast of ''Emberstrike'' puts '''Shyvana's''' basic attack on cooldown.
** In {{sbc|Human Form}}, only Q2 will put it on cooldown; in {{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}}, only Q3 will.
** This results in the same functionality as {{cai|Shield of Daybreak|Leona}} and {{cai|Thundering Smash|Volibear}}, effectively being a triple/quintuple attack reset.
<!--blurb-->

Against non-champions damaged by abilities, the generated amount is reduced to{{ft|25%.|{{as|{{ap|1.25*0.25}}|Fury}} and {{tt|{{as|{{ap|1.25*3*0.25}}|Fury}}|After applying the {{fd|3}}x Fury generation multiplier while in Dragon Form}} {{as|Dragon Fury}} during {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Dragon Form}}, respectively.}}'''Shyvana''' gains 1% '''bonus''' {{as|Dragon Fury}} generation from all sources per 1 [[ultimate haste]]. params.notes:
* ''Dragon's Descent's'' {{tip|displacement immunity}} begins from the start of the cast time.
* Ultimate haste acquired while '''Shyvana''' is dead does not grant bonus {{as|Dragon Fury}} generation until she respawns.
* ''{{ais|Emberstrike|Shyvana}}'' attack against the primary target will generate the full {{as|Dragon Fury}} amount even if they're a non-champion.
** The attack's area of effect will generate reduced {{as|Dragon Fury}} for secondary targets damaged.
{{ct|cast|spells=true,false,false,false,false}}
params.tips:
* Because of how [[ultimate haste]] interacts with '''Shyvana's''' fury generation, it has a bigger effect than haste has on abilities with a regular cooldown.
** ''Dragon's Descent'' essentially has a cooldown of {{ap|100/0.5|100/{{#var:fb2}}|100/1|round=3}} seconds, reduced by {{ap|1.25/0.5*0.25|1.25/{{#var:fb2}}*0.25|1.25/1*0.25|round=4}} for each damaging basic attack and ability hit, increased to {{ap|1.25/0.5|1.25/{{#var:fb2}}|1.25/1|round=2}} against champions.
** It also essentially lasts for {{ap|(100/(10/3))/2}} seconds, increased by {{ap|((1.25*3*0.25)/(10/3))/2}} for each basic attack and ability hit, increased to {{ap|(1.25*3/(10/3))/2}} against champions.
*** Normally, with {{ap|100}} haste, the only effect would be the cooldown getting reduced by {{ap|100/(100+100)*100|round=2}}% to {{ap|100/0.5*100/(100+100)|100/{{#var:fb2}}*100/(100+100)|100/1*100/(100+100)|round=3}}, but because 100 ultimate haste grants '''Shyvana''' an extra {{ap|100}}% '''bonus''' fury generation from '''all''' sources, this also increases how much the "cooldown" is reduced by basic attacks and abilities to {{ap|(1.25/0.5*0.25)*(100+100)/100|(1.25/{{#var:fb2}}*0.25)*(100+100)/100|(1.25/1*0.25)*(100+100)/100|round=4}} for non-champions and {{ap|(1.25/0.5)*(100+100)/100|(1.25/{{#var:fb2}})*(100+100)/100|(1.25/1)*(100+100)/100|round=2}} for champions. 
**** This is the opposite effect to abilities with cooldown reductions that scale with haste (e.g. {{cai|Alpha Strike|Master Yi}}), which instead lower the reduction amount with haste. This happens because ultimate haste increases fury generation from ''all'' sources instead of only increasing her passive fury generation.
*** Additionally, this also affects the duration increase per basic attack or ability the same way, amounting to an extra {{ap|(((1.25*3*0.25)/(10/3))/2)*(100+100)/100}} against non-champions and {{ap|((1.25*3/(10/3))/2)*(100+100)/100}} against champions.
<!--blurb-->
